Objective: Make hero name "KEN TAYLOR" split into two lines on mobile (KEN on top, TAYLOR below), keep single line on desktop. Context: File `src/pages/index.astro`. Hero h1 renders letters as individual `.letter` spans with staggered animation. Current code uses ` ` (4th child) as the space between KEN and TAYLOR. The `:nth-child` animation delays (1-10) must stay aligned — do NOT renumber them. Constraints: - Tailwind CSS v4 project (no tailwind.config.js, use utility classes) - Preserve all existing animation delays and nth-child mapping - Keep desktop appearance identical (KEN TAYLOR on one line) - On mobile: KEN on first line, TAYLOR on second line, centered Action Steps: 1. In `src/pages/index.astro`, find the h1 with the letter spans (around line 70-85). 2. Replace the ` ` (the space between N and T) with: `
` 3. On the `T` letter span (the one right after the replaced space), add `md:ml-[0.25em]` class so desktop keeps a space between KEN and TAYLOR. Keep all existing classes on that span (hover:text-accent transition-colors duration-300 cursor-default). 4. Verify: the `
` is NOT a `.letter` class element, so it won't affect nth-child counting of `.letter` spans (nth-child counts ALL siblings, but the animation selectors target `.letter:nth-child(n)` — since br is child 4, the T becomes child 5 which already has delay 0.62s... wait, this WILL shift numbering). IMPORTANT — nth-child fix: The `.letter:nth-child(N)` selectors count ALL children including the `
`. Currently child 4 is the ` ` span (has `.letter` but no hover). If you replace it with `
`, the T span shifts from child 5 to child 4, breaking animation sync. Solution: Change the CSS selectors from `.letter:nth-child(N)` to `.letter:nth-of-type(N)` so they only count `.letter` elements (spans), ignoring the `
`. The `
` is not a span so `nth-of-type` for spans stays stable. Update all 10 `.letter:nth-child` rules to `.letter:nth-of-type`. Deliverables: - `src/pages/index.astro` updated - Mobile: KEN / TAYLOR stacked, centered - Desktop: KEN TAYLOR inline with space - Animation delays unchanged (letters still animate in order K-E-N-T-A-Y-L-O-R) - Reply with confirmation and any notes.
